// diagnostic

E0357

An identifier is not written in the casing required for its grammatical category.

What

An identifier is not written in the casing required for its grammatical category.

Why

Jet enforces PascalCase for type-like names, snake_case for value-like names, and ALL_CAPS (SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE) for module-global constants. During `jet check`, Jet reports this diagnostic.

Fix

Rename the identifier to the exact spelling shown by the diagnostic. Foreign names inside FFI binding modules are exempt.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0357: tests/ui/casing_trailing_underscore.stderr.

Error [jet.CasingMismatch]: Method `where_` must be snake_case
  --> tests/ui/casing_trailing_underscore.jet:7:8
    |
  7 |     fn where_(self) -> Int { self.sides }
    |        ^^^^^^
 Why: Jet enforces PascalCase for type-like names, snake_case for value-like names, and ALL_CAPS (SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE) for module-global constants
 Fix: Rename it: a name can't end with `_`, so pick another word
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0357

    |     ^^^^^
 Why: Jet enforces PascalCase for type-like names, snake_case for value-like names, and ALL_CAPS (SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE) for module-global constants
 Fix: Rename it: a name can't end with `_`, so pick another word
